name: Hero
description: Mortar marketing hero, using central semantic tokens.

props.title: string
props.id: string (the root element's id, e.g. an in-page link target)
props.className: string (layout only: margins or grid placement)
props.layout: "center" | "split" | "angled" (default center). angled: copy beside an image (children) that fills the end half to the edge on a slant
props.images: ReactNode[] (image tiles shown as a staggered collage beside or below the copy; use instead of children)
props.tone: "default" | "accent" (default "default"; accent: a full-bleed band of the brand's accent fill, its gradient when it defines one, with on-accent copy and actions; the preview keeps the page's colours; a background takes precedence)
props.emphasis: string (a phrase in the title to emphasise: its first occurrence renders as <em class="m-emphasis"> inside the one heading, in the brand's link colour; a phrase not in the title is ignored, so the title stays a plain string)
props.note: ReactNode (short supporting content below the actions, such as a note or a Notice)
props.wide: "copy" | "preview" (split only: the column that takes three fifths of the width; omitted, the columns are even; narrow screens stack them)

contract.usage: Import { Hero } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states. The root element exposes data-m-component for tests and consumers. It is not a styling hook.
